text:
alex_kim: heads up — noticed a 12-18% p99 increase on the canary fleet after last night's CUDA driver update (535.86). Affected: redwood-7b on seq=512 workloads. kv-cache hit rate unchanged, but latency spiked on _small_ batches.

maria_chen: saw this too. batcher traces show autotuner switched to a grid-optimized matmul kernel for these shapes. Previously we were hitting a shared-memory path that was faster at seq<=512.

ryan_patel: quick summary from the microtrace: kernel selection score changed because the profiler reports lower SM occupancy after the driver update, so the autotuner favored a kernel with higher compute throughput but worse latency for short sequences. Could be driver reporting different occupancy counters.

alex_kim: nvprof snippet (cropped):
```
== PROGRESS: Kernel summary ==
MatMul_shared   0.23ms  45%
MatMul_grid     0.38ms  72%  <-- now selected
KV_Read         0.05ms  10%
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy 1823456700 -> 1823456720 (cuda-driver-upgrade #2024) :information_source:

anya_ivanova: options: 1) force runtime kernel override for seq<=512, 2) roll back driver on canary nodes, 3) tweak autotuner weights + collect more telemetry. I can push a quick override if we want to mitigate immediately. Example config: 
```
{
  "kernel_override": "MatMul_shared",
  "seq_threshold": 512,
  "autotune_trace": true
}
```

sam_ortiz: short-term I think rollback on canary + enable verbose autotune logging so we can reproduce locally. We should avoid a code change unless necessary.

maria_chen: agree. I'll open an infra ticket to pin driver on canary to 530.41 and add a flag so we can re-enable 535.x once autotuner is adjusted. Also adding a metric: "autotuner.selected_kernel" + seq histogram to console.

ryan_patel: follow-ups: add guard in autotuner that ignores tiny reported occupancy deltas (<5%) when deciding between shared vs grid kernels; and emit the scoring vector for each decision. That will help us catch driver-reporting-induced flips.

alex_kim: plan: rollback canary driver now, monitor p99 for next 30m. If stable, schedule staged rollout with extra autotune telemetry and a short A/B comparing override vs tuned policy. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback job queued (job id: roll-canary-2026).

maria_chen: filing infra ticket: INFRA-1129. Adding owners: @anya_ivanova, @sam_ortiz.

ryan_patel: I'll draft the autotune change and a small perf test harness to reproduce the split locally.

alex_kim: thanks all — keeping this thread for roll status.
